title: Community language packs
description: Install translations shared by the community without rebuilding Watch Party.
builtins: English and German are included. Removing an uploaded German pack restores the included translation.
format_hint: Start with the template ZIP. Edit its language name and code in manifest.json, translate the JSON files, then upload the ZIP. Missing translations use English.
replacement_hint: A pack with the same language code replaces the installed version. English cannot be replaced.
author: By {author}
confirm_remove: Remove {name}? Viewers using this pack will return to an included language.
refresh_pending: The change was saved. Language choices could not refresh yet; they will update when the connection recovers.
list_failed: Could not load installed languages. Try refreshing the list.
upload_failed: Could not install the language pack. Your selected file is kept so you can try again.
remove_failed: Could not remove the language pack. Try again.
template_failed: Could not download the translation template. Try again.
zip_required: Choose a ZIP file containing a language pack.
size_limit: Choose a non-empty ZIP file no larger than 1 MiB.
